verdict.rationale: The API's own documented file search and tool features let the model use your files and data as input and return AI-generated responses, so insight generation from your data exists as a first-party capability. However, it is delivered as API calls a developer must wire up, not as a packaged in-product insights or suggestions experience. missing for 10: a documented in-product insights/suggestions feature over user data, worked examples of data-analysis insight generation, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: use built-in tools like web search or file search to use your own data as input for the model's response
These enable the model to search the web, retrieve from your files
you can use a large language model to generate text from a prompt
